# JWKS tolerance test data

Generated by `gen/generate.py`. Re-run it to regenerate; keys in `keys/` are reused so output is stable.

- `token.jwt`: RS256 JWT, header `kid: rsa-1`, expires 2100-01-01.
- `rsa-1.public.pem`, `rsa-1.public.jwk.json`: the signing key.
- `jwks/*.json`: one JWK Set per case. Each lists the odd key(s) first and `rsa-1` last.
- `cases.json`: manifest of cases with description, RFC rule, and expected result.
- `keys/`: private keys used to build the odd entries. Test material only.

**Every case is expected to verify `token.jwt`.** A library that rejects a set is failing to
ignore something RFC 7517 says it should ignore.

| Prefix | What is unusual | RFC 7517 |
|---|---|---|
| `00` | Nothing (harness sanity check) | |
| `A` | AKP keys: pure ML-DSA (RFC 9964) and the 7 composites from draft-ietf-jose-pq-composite-sigs-06. Public keys come from `gen/vectors/`. | §5 SHOULD ignore |
| `B` | Unknown `kty` | §5 SHOULD ignore |
| `C` | Known `kty`, unsupported `crv` / `alg` / size | §5 SHOULD ignore ("out of the supported ranges") |
| `D` | Known `kty`, missing required member | §5 SHOULD ignore |
| `E01`-`E04` | Unknown members on `rsa-1` itself; the key must still be used | §4 MUST ignore member |
| `E05` | Unknown member on the JWK Set object | §5 MUST ignore member |
| `E06`-`E07` | Unknown `use` / `key_ops` values on another key | §4.2 / §4.3 MAY be used |
| `Z01` | All of the above in one set | |
